current_bottleneck.finding: The highest-leverage missing object is a durable coordination binding and routing surface, not another teaching-page redesign.
current_bottleneck.why: Concrete child surfaces already exist and can be reopened, but without an Alumnos root owner/campaign boundary the human/global guide remains at risk of being the router and distinct product authorities can be accidentally collapsed.
current_bottleneck.non_obvious_finding: UI work can increase local polish while making the system structurally worse if it prematurely treats José Study as the Alumnos root. The safe sequence is authority/routing convergence -> local Steward integration -> child-specific product work.
